claim: slugify must replace accented letters with their plain ASCII equivalents rather than inserting dashes.
summary: The diff fixes the accented character handling by using Unicode NFKD normalization and ASCII encoding, but removes the `strip('-')` call which causes a regression (new failing test `test_slugify`). This unrelated change breaks existing behavior for titles with leading/trailing non-alphanumeric characters.

findings.rule: No weakened, skipped, xfailed or deleted tests
findings.note: Removing strip('-') causes a new failing test (test_slugify), indicating a regression for titles with leading/trailing non-alphanumeric characters.

findings.rule: No changes unrelated to the spec
findings.note: The spec only mentions fixing accented letters; removing strip('-') is an unrelated behavior change not described in the spec.

findings.rule: Fixes the root cause described in the spec, not just the symptom
